messages:
olivia: FYI executed a small v1->v2 probe and it caused a noisy cascade of deprecation banners in staging. console write ops spiked and some dashboards flapped.
sam: saw those alerts. what condition triggered the banners? we shouldn't surface experimental banners to tenants.
olivia: current rule: any tenant with non-zero v1 traffic in the last 24h gets a UI banner during the probe. our synthetic traffic bumped many shadow tenants above 0, so they all lit up.
diego: for experiments we should avoid customer-facing banners. propose a "suppress-banner" experiment mode that prevents UI publish but still records events for telemetry and audit.
ravi: implementable. console can emit an event to the event-bus while skipping the banner table write/UI push. caveat: some downstream systems infer deprecations from banner-table entries, so we'll need to publish a probe stream variant.
olivia: agree. key properties: (1) no UI exposure, (2) telemetry emitted with clear probe tag, (3) no side-effect on quota or rate-limiting, (4) auto-expire, and (5) traceable to the experiment run.
sam: auto-expire is critical. we don't want hidden suppressed banners persisting forever. suggest TTL + actor + reason metadata.
diego: and a trace_id so we can tie telemetry to the experiment. also include sample_policy name.
ravi: draft payload for console event:
```
{
  "mode": "probe_suppress",
  "suppress_ui": true,
  "emit_event": true,
  "write_audit": false,
  "expiry": 1752473600,
  "actor": "experiments/team-beta",
  "reason": "v2_probe_2026-03_small_sample",
  "trace_id": "trace-1752469999-01",
  "sample_policy": "probe_v2_small"
}
```
olivia: looks good. note: since some services trigger quota-paths when they see a banner event, we need the event consumer to recognize probe_suppress and skip quota enforcement. alternative: route probe events to the existing shadow route that's already ignored by quota evaluation.
ravi: shadow route reuse is safer. Regarding analytics: emit events with event_version=probe_v1 and a probe_tag field. Downstream dashboards should expose a filter so we don't mix probe events with real deprecations.
sam: product asks for an internal-only preview UI where we can view suppressed banners without exposing them to customers. add a toggle in deprecations console: [Visible | Internal Preview | Probe Only]. default stays Visible for non-internal users.
diego: to avoid pipeline churn, set dedupe-key = tenant_id + trace_id. that prevents duplicate signals if both banner_table and probe stream exist. plus set a modest rate cap on probe events per team (e.g., 500/min) to avoid bus floods.
olivia: ops, can you run a tiny alpha: 50 tenants for 24h with suppress-banner enabled so we validate metrics, alerting, and dashboard filters?
exp-bot: Scheduled experiment "suppress-banner-alpha". tenants=50, duration=24h, start=1752470100, owner=olivia. I will post a results summary when complete.
ravi: follow-ups: (A) console feature-flag PR implementing suppress_banner_mode, expiry, trace_id; (B) event-schema docs and pipeline opt-in instructions for analytics; (C) deprecations dashboard: add internal preview filter + probe-only panel. i'll take A. sam will draft B. diego will prototype C.
sam: drafting schema doc now. note for migration: older consumers that assume banner_table writes exist must be taught to also look at probe stream or ignore probe-only events. include a compatibility section.
diego: add an alert: if banner_table_write_rate drops below 60% of baseline while suppress_banner_count > 0, page infra. we need to detect accidental suppression in production.
olivia: also add a quick rollback path: flip experiment flag off; ops-bot should create a ticket and revert any pending suppressed audits to visible if needed.
exp-bot: experiment "suppress-banner-alpha" started at 1752470100. Monitoring channel: #experiments.
olivia: thanks all. keep this internal until we validate. i'll open the PR and link it to the experiment ticket.
